summary: Iteration 4 testing focused on battle mode, QTE, and death recap screen. Village explore mode, enemies, HUD, and menu all working correctly. CRITICAL ISSUE: Battle trigger zone (x:27-29, y:5-8) is not accessible - player cannot reach the battle area despite extended navigation attempts (40+ seconds of movement). This blocks testing of battle mode, QTE overlay, death recap screen, and ending screen.

integration_issues.issue: Battle trigger zone at x:27-29, y:5-8 is not accessible. Player cannot reach the trigger zone despite extended navigation (40+ seconds of movement in all directions). The path on the map appears to lead to the edge but the trigger is not activated.

issues: Very small font size (0.45rem) may be hard to read on some displays - carried over from previous iterations

action_items: CRITICAL: Fix battle trigger zone accessibility - player cannot reach x:27-29, y:5-8 from starting position x:5, y:10
Investigate collision detection at map edges - the path appears to lead to the trigger zone but player cannot reach it
Consider adding a debug mode or teleport option to test battle features independently
Verify VILLAGE_MAP has accessible path to trigger zone (rows 7-8 should have path tiles leading to columns 27-29)
critical_code_review_comments: Battle trigger zone (x:27-29, y:5-8) may be blocked by solid tiles or collision detection issues
VILLAGE_MAP row 7 shows path (1) at columns 24-25 and 29, but columns 26-28 may be blocked
Player movement speed (PLAYER_SPEED) may be too slow to reach the trigger zone in reasonable time
Village enemies deal continuous damage which drops player HP to 0, but there's no death handling in explore mode

rca_of_the_issue: Root cause analysis: The battle trigger zone at x:27-29, y:5-8 appears to be inaccessible. Possible causes: 1) Collision detection blocking player at map edges, 2) Path tiles not leading to trigger zone (VILLAGE_MAP may have gaps), 3) Player movement speed too slow, 4) Trigger zone coordinates may be outside walkable area. The VILLAGE_MAP shows cliff tiles (4) at the edges which are solid. The path at rows 7-8 leads towards the right edge but may not reach columns 27-29.
